expression: {f: function(n) f(n + 1), r: for i in 1..10000000 return f(i)}.r
why: An evaluation stopped by a limit is reported as an `evaluation` error, never as a partial result (docs/CONTRACT.md §2; DMN 1.6 §7.3.8: the evaluation "MUST report or log diagnostic information"). The call-depth limit stops the evaluation at the first item, but the previous release ran the loop on through its 10,000,000 iterations, refusing each call and holding a null for each, and exhausted the module's memory; a loop now ends at the abort and answers its error.

error.message: function calls are nested too deeply (more than 200 levels, e.g. runaway recursion); evaluation stopped
